title: Apps
description: Every app in the open ledger's `apps/`, and every app a card names that has no folder there, each with its state as the board works it out now.
$comment: Was: D-047 rulings 11-12; packages/format APP_STATES, AppInfo

id.description: The app's id: its folder's name.

state.description: `ready`: its panel shows and its tools run. `needs-approval`: it has tools and the person has not allowed this version of its code. `invalid`: fix the `problems`. `broken`: its tools crashed too often; change the code to try again. `missing`: a card names it, but no folder has it.

size.description: The panel size for a card that sets none: the manifest's, else the default.

tools.description: Its tools' names, once the person allowed this version and its tools first ran (nothing runs before that); empty until then, and for an app with a panel only.

hash.description: The SHA-256 of its code now (its manifest, then its tools file): the version the person allows.

allowed.description: True when the person allowed this `hash`. Only the person allows an app, on its card.

changed.description: The person allowed an earlier version, and the code has changed since; the card asks again.

problems.description: What to fix, when its state is `invalid` or `broken`.

file.description: The file in the app's folder, such as `app.json`.

pointer.description: Where in `app.json`, as a JSON Pointer such as /csp/connectDomains/0.

detail.description: What is wrong and what to do.
